title: GIF export: finite Loop count ignored (plays once instead of N times)
description:
ExportGifDialog exposes a 'Loop count' number input (1-65535, shown when 'Loop forever' is unchecked), but the value has ZERO effect on the produced GIF.

Repro/evidence (validated against gifenc 1.0.3, the real encoder):
- packages/authoring-ui/src/hooks/useExportHandlers.ts:162 sets `const repeat = options.loopForever ? 0 : -1;` and passes `repeat` only on frame 0 (line 185).
- gifenc treats repeat=-1 as 'write NO NETSCAPE2.0 application extension'. With no extension, a GIF plays exactly ONCE regardless of options.loopCount.
- Parsed a 2-frame GIF encoded with loopForever=false: NO NETSCAPE2.0 extension present (netscapeLoop=null) -> plays once. options.loopCount (e.g. 5) is never encoded anywhere.

Expected vs actual:
- Expected: loopForever=false + loopCount=N -> NETSCAPE2.0 extension with loop iteration count = N (the 2-byte LE loop count field in the NETSCAPE sub-block; 0 = forever, N = repeat N additional times).
- Actual: no extension emitted; loopCount discarded; GIF plays once.

Fix sketch: gifenc's GIFEncoder.writeFrame repeat param maps directly to the NETSCAPE loop count when >= 0 (0=forever, N=finite). Pass `repeat = options.loopForever ? 0 : options.loopCount` on the first frame instead of -1. Verify the emitted NETSCAPE2.0 sub-block carries the count. (gifenc DOES support finite counts via a non-negative repeat; the code comment at useExportHandlers.ts:159-161 claiming it 'does not natively encode finite loop counts' is incorrect.)

Note: this is the ONLY functional defect found in a proactive QA of GIF export; header/dims/frame-count/per-frame-delay/loop-forever/pixel-capture all validate correctly. Found by e2e QA agent (HEAD ff50e93).
